name: Prompt/tool tenant isolation
verification: Cross-tenant context must never enter prompts, retrieval results, tool arguments or agent memory.

name: Tool allowlist
verification: Agents may call only explicitly registered tools permitted by policy and actor scope.

name: High-risk approval
verification: Protected write/approve/send/export actions require configured human approval.

name: Prompt injection
verification: Retrieved documents/webhook/tool outputs cannot modify system/tool/security policy.

name: Sensitive redaction
verification: Secrets and restricted data are filtered/redacted before model transmission according to policy.

name: Provider policy
verification: Only approved providers/models may process each data classification/risk class.

name: Evidence permission
verification: Citations cannot expose documents/records the user lacks permission to open.

name: AI audit
verification: Model, prompt, tool, actor, tenant, input evidence, output and approval traces are auditable for consequential tasks.

name: Background-agent scope
verification: Autonomous runs use bounded service identity/actor authority, expiry and task scope.

name: Memory retention
verification: Conversation/agent memory follows configured retention and deletion rules.

name: AI incident kill switch
verification: High-risk AI capability/model/tool can be disabled quickly by authorized operators.

name: Model supply chain
verification: Model/prompt/tool releases are versioned, reviewed and integrity tracked.

name: No training leakage
verification: Tenant data is not reused for external/provider training unless an explicit approved policy allows it.

name: Output encoding
verification: AI-generated content used in UI/API/file contexts is safely encoded/validated before execution/rendering.
